scope: 2024–2026 VLA lineage and direct collisions, integrated with 9 prior broad-field questions; 4 VLA lenses plus 9 broad lenses
claim_boundary: field gap candidates are researcher interpretations; no prior-work absence, novelty, efficacy, reading completion or GO established

query_families: heterogeneous generalist VLA CrossFormer HPT Octo
human video latent action LAPA UniVLA distractors view invariance
VLA tactile force sensor distillation controller
VLA memory long horizon intervention MIKASA RoboMME
VLA continual learning forgetting replay normalization phase coverage
VLA navigation NaVILA OmniVLA physical grounding
limits: Selective scoping review, not exhaustive venue-by-venue coverage.
Primary official pages prioritized; preprints retained for nearest-collision checks.
Current VLA pass concentrates on CoRL/RSS/NeurIPS/ICLR/ICML/CVPR/ICCV; ICRA author-only entry kept distinct.
ECCV/IROS/T-RO and other field evidence reused from GAP-W1, not newly reread this pass.
TaF-VLA T-RO assertion not confirmed on publisher, so retained as preprint; IJRR/Science Robotics coverage remains limited.
OpenReview challenge left task-centric latent-action acceptance unresolved.
No local PDF download, dependency install, simulation, inference or learning.
